subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Liyue Adventurers' Guild

716640101.text: Ah, I've been waiting for you, Traveler.

716640102.text: Recently, the Adventurers' Guild has received a rather important commission. Judging from my experience, you are the best person for the job.

716640105.text: Oh, come on. Don't worry, Katheryne, we're used to it already!

716640106.text: And you wouldn't have troubled us if the rewards weren't worth it either, right?

716640107.text: Well, that is true... As expected of the two of you — as straightforward as ever.

716640108.text: Well, then I will get straight to the point as well. The person who gave this commission out is named Patrice, and he is a researcher from Fontaine.

716640109.text: He hopes to get a few assistants to help him conduct his studies. He is presently inspecting the outskirts of The Chasm.

716640110.text: Although we were not given a great amount of detail concerning the nature of this research, I believe that you are quite used to such commissions...

716640112.text: Well, let's do it like we always do. First up, to The Chasm!

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for Patrice near The Chasm

716640201.text: We can't have any more delays. We need to move onto the verification stage as soon as possible... Worse comes to worst, I'll do it myself.

716640202.text: "Research halted temporarily due to accidental injury." I think that'll buy me some time...

716640203.text: As long as I don't lose my life, I'd call it a better trade than having to go to court back home!

716640204.text: #What's he talking to himself about? Let's go say hi, {NICKNAME}.

716640206.text: Aaahhh! Where did you two come from... and how do you know my name?

716640207.text: Wait, you aren't plainclothes Millelith, are you? Are you here to kick me out? I've already shown you my field inspection permit!

716640208.text: I swear to you, I did not enter any restricted areas! If you don't believe me, go ask that black-haired, fierce-looking lady!

716640209.text: Uh, Paimon doesn't know who you're talking about, but you can relax.

716640210.text: We're friendly, professional adventurers. We received your commission from the Guild, and we're here to help!

716640211.text: Oh, so you're the reinforcements? Wonderful, wonderful! Now that you're here, we finally have a chance! I was going to die here at this rate...

716640212.text: Wow, your research sounds more like torture...

716640213.text: No, no! Research itself is sacred! The highest calling! The thing in my way is what one might call... additional factors.

716640215.text: Well, like how I will kick the bucket should this research fail.

716640220.text: Independent researchers must apply for funding to conduct their studies, but using them means that you'll be assuming the social responsibility that comes with their use.

716640221.text: To spend large sums and not produce any results therefore makes you no different from a criminal deserving of judgment!

716640222.text: If I return empty-handed, I will almost certainly face at least a few dozen charges, including but not limited to, "wasting public funds" and "misappropriating academic resources."

716640223.text: Such crimes will surely land me the harshest punishments... Never mind the bankruptcy or the sullying of my name — if I am indeed judged, I might really die!

716640224.text: Eh? That sounds way too extreme!

716640225.text: So is that why you put up so much Mora for assistants to help you?
